name: xml2
resume: All 67 function exports are done. The four classes are the node types those functions return. Documents, XPath, schema checks, and URLs call the system libxml2 through ctypes, the library the installed package links. download_xml uses urllib. cli and rlang are not opened: their calls here are error text and one boolean. curl is suggested, and a curl handle is unused. There is no Fortran, so there is no crate.

functions.name: read_xml
functions.done: Reads a string, file, or URL with libxml2. A string that contains < is markup.

functions.name: read_html
functions.done: Reads HTML with libxml2 recovery. The default encoding is UTF-8.

functions.name: xml_name
functions.done: The tag name. A namespace map qualifies it as prefix:name.

check.case: the children of a mixed element

functions.name: xml_text
functions.done: Concatenated descendant text. trim drops leading and trailing spaces, including a non-breaking space.

check.case: text of a paragraph and its child

functions.name: xml_double
functions.done: xml_text parsed with R's as.numeric. A non-number is missing.

functions.name: xml_integer
functions.done: xml_text parsed with R's as.integer. A decimal word is missing.

functions.name: xml_set_text
functions.done: Replaces the first text node, or appends one when the element has none.

functions.name: xml_text<-
functions.done: The replacement form of xml_set_text.

functions.name: xml_type
functions.done: libxml2's node type: element, text, cdata, and the rest of that table.

functions.name: xml_children
functions.done: Element children, de-duplicated.

functions.name: xml_contents
functions.done: Every child, including text and cdata.

functions.name: xml_child
functions.done: One child by position, counting from 1, or by name.

functions.name: xml_siblings
functions.done: Element siblings of a node, not the node itself.

functions.name: xml_parent
functions.done: The parent node.

functions.name: xml_parents
functions.done: Element ancestors, nearest first.

functions.name: xml_length
functions.done: How many children. only_elements is true unless you ask for every node.

functions.name: xml_root
functions.done: The document element.

functions.name: xml_attr
functions.done: One attribute. A missing attribute is NA. With a namespace map, an unqualified name is the attribute in no namespace.

check.case: id of the root, and a missing apple

functions.name: xml_has_attr
functions.done: True when xml_attr would not be missing. An empty value still counts.

functions.name: xml_attrs
functions.done: Every attribute, then every namespace declaration. Duplicate local names stay in order.

check.case: id and d on the second child

functions.name: xml_set_attr
functions.done: Sets one attribute. None removes it.

functions.name: xml_attr<-
functions.done: The replacement form of xml_set_attr.

functions.name: xml_set_attrs
functions.done: Replaces the whole attribute set. Names that disappear are removed.

functions.name: xml_attrs<-
functions.done: The replacement form of xml_set_attrs.

functions.name: xml_set_name
functions.done: Renames an element. The namespace map is ignored.

functions.name: xml_name<-
functions.done: The replacement form of xml_set_name.

functions.name: xml_path
functions.done: The XPath of a node, from libxml2.

functions.name: xml_find_all
functions.done: Every node an XPath returns, de-duplicated. flatten=False keeps one nodeset per input node.

functions.name: xml_find_first
functions.done: The first match for each node. No match is a missing node.

check.case: text of the first b in each paragraph

functions.name: xml_find_one
functions.done: The old name of xml_find_first.

functions.name: xml_find_num
functions.done: An XPath number. NaN is returned as NaN.

functions.name: xml_find_int
functions.done: An XPath number that is a whole number, as an integer.

functions.name: xml_find_chr
functions.done: An XPath string.

functions.name: xml_find_lgl
functions.done: An XPath boolean.

functions.name: xml_ns
functions.done: Prefix to URL, first seen. Default namespaces are d1, d2, in document order.

functions.name: xml_ns_rename
functions.done: Renames prefixes in place. The URL stays with the old position.

check.case: d1 and d2 become foo and bar

functions.name: xml_ns_strip
functions.done: Removes default namespace declarations so an unprefixed name matches.

functions.name: xml_set_namespace
functions.done: Points a node at a namespace that an ancestor already declared.

functions.name: xml_add_child
functions.done: Appends a child. .where is the child after which to insert, counting from 1. 0 inserts first.

check.case: a root with a cdata child

functions.name: xml_add_sibling
functions.done: Inserts a sibling after the node, or before it.

functions.name: xml_add_parent
functions.done: Wraps a node in a new parent.

functions.name: xml_replace
functions.done: Replaces a node and returns the new one.

functions.name: xml_remove
functions.done: Unlinks a node. free=True also frees it.

functions.name: xml_cdata
functions.done: Marks text that xml_add_child inserts as CDATA.

functions.name: xml_comment
functions.done: Marks text that xml_add_child inserts as a comment.

functions.name: xml_dtd
functions.done: A document type declaration on a new document.

functions.name: xml_new_document
functions.done: An empty document with a version and encoding.

functions.name: xml_new_root
functions.done: A new document whose root is the given name or node.

functions.name: xml_missing
functions.done: The stand-in for a node that was not found.

check.case: missing, and its text is NA

functions.name: xml_structure
functions.done: Prints the element tree without text values.

check.case: a, b, two c, and d

functions.name: html_structure
functions.done: The element tree, with #id and .class on the tag.

functions.name: as_list
functions.done: A nested list. Element names are the names, attributes are attributes, and text is a character.

functions.name: as_xml_document
functions.done: A named list becomes a document. One root is required. Attributes on the list become attributes.

functions.name: write_xml
functions.done: Writes a document or one node with libxml2's save flags. format is the default.

functions.name: write_html
functions.done: Writes with the same saver as write_xml.

functions.name: xml_validate
functions.done: Validates a document against an XML schema. Errors are kept on the result.

functions.name: xml_serialize
functions.done: Stores the XML text and whether it was a document, a node, or a nodeset, then xml_unserialize reads it back.

functions.name: xml_unserialize
functions.done: Reads what xml_serialize stored.

functions.name: xml_url
functions.done: The document URL. A literal string has none, so the result is missing.

functions.name: url_absolute
functions.done: libxml2 xmlBuildURI.

functions.name: url_relative
functions.done: libxml2 xmlBuildRelativeURI.

check.case: the same target against four bases

functions.name: url_escape
functions.done: libxml2 xmlURIEscapeStr. reserved lists characters that stay literal.

functions.name: url_unescape
functions.done: libxml2 xmlURIUnescapeString.

check.case: a space, a slash, and micro

functions.name: url_parse
functions.done: libxml2 xmlParseURI. Port 0 is missing. The query is the raw query.

check.case: scheme, server, port, path, query, and fragment

functions.name: xml2_example
functions.done: The sample files shipped with the package.

functions.name: download_xml
functions.done: Downloads a URL into a file. urllib does the transfer. A curl handle is accepted and unused.

check.case: the bundled order document via a file URL

functions.name: download_html
functions.done: The same download as download_xml.

check.case: the bundled order document via a file URL
